author: GameSpot
description:
Watch the official Opening Movie for MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls! 
Blending the intensity of classic fighting game intros with the style, heart, and energy of iconic early-2000s anime openings, this cinematic opening sets the stage for the battles ahead.

Produced by renowned Japanese animation studio Sanzigen, the opening animation is directed by Daisuke Suzuki. 
The original theme song, "Stronger as One," features powerhouse vocalists Keiko Terada (SHOW-YA) and mayu (NEMOPHILA), with lyrics by Kanata Okajima and music composed and arranged by MEG (MEGMETAL).

Experience the world of MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls before stepping into the fight.

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
